title: Georgia Elects Keisha Lance Bottoms as First Black Woman Governor in U.S. History
summary:
Georgia voters made history this week. They elected Keisha Lance Bottoms as the state's first Democratic governor in more than two decades, and the first Black woman ever elected governor in the United States.

Bottoms is the former mayor of Atlanta. She campaigned on lowering the cost of living, expanding access to health care, and pushing back against the Trump administration. She will take office in a state where Republicans still control the Senate, so she will need their support to pass many of her plans.

The victory is deeply personal for her. Her family has lived in Georgia for at least five generations, and she can trace her roots to a plantation in Crawfordville, where her great-great-grandparents were once enslaved. 'To have come from people who had to toil the soul of Georgia, and to now be elected governor has exceeded every dream that I ever had for my life,' she said.

Bottoms said the win was the result of decades of work by many people across Georgia, including groups that never appear on national news. Georgia has not elected a Democratic governor since 1998. She said she has not yet spoken with Stacey Abrams, who ran for governor herself and spent years building the political network that helped make Georgia competitive for Democrats.

Her message for the national Democratic Party is to listen to voters and focus on the issues that shape daily life, especially the cost of living. Democrats also won the Georgia House this time and are one seat away from controlling the Senate. 'We're going to try and find those things that we can get bipartisan agreement on,' Bottoms said, 'those things we can get done immediately.'
why_it_matters: A governor's choices shape daily life in a state, from the cost of living to health care, and this election also shows how years of organizing by many people can change who holds power.

keywords.explanation: Bipartisan means people from two different political parties working together.
A plantation is a large farm where crops were grown long ago, often by enslaved workers.
Enslaved means forced to work for someone else with no freedom and no pay.
To toil means to work very hard for a long time.
Competitive means both sides have a real chance of winning.

background_read: A governor is the leader of a state's government, in charge of carrying out state laws and working with the state's lawmakers on new plans.
In Georgia, the governor works with two lawmaking groups, the House and the Senate, and needs their agreement to pass most new laws.
Voters choose a governor in an election, and candidates often campaign on everyday issues such as the cost of living and health care.
Bottoms previously served as mayor of Atlanta before running for governor.
